compact_tables false (default) pads cells to column width

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Score</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>100</td></tr><tr><td>Bob</td><td>42</td></tr></tbody></table>", new ConversionOptions { CompactTables = false });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
